performance.finding: Signals are crisis detectors. Strong in volatile/fearful markets (55%+), weak in low-vol bulls (39%). Recommend widening neutral threshold when VIX<15 and GEX positive.

regime_guidance.high_vol_signals_strong: VIX>20 or GEX negative: signals historically 55%+ accurate. Trust the weights.
regime_guidance.low_vol_signals_weak: VIX<15 and GEX positive: signals historically 39% accurate. Widen neutral zone, reduce confidence by 20%, avoid directional calls without 3+ confirming signals.
regime_guidance.crisis_detector: These weights are best at detecting mean-reversion opportunities during fear/oversold conditions. They are NOT trend-following signals.
